segments.he: נָתַן לוֹ אֶת הַקֶּרֶן וְכוּ׳. אַלְמָא חוֹמֶשׁ מָמוֹנָא הוּא, וְאִם מָיֵית – מְשַׁלְּמִי לֵיהּ יוֹרְשִׁין.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that if the robber «gave» the robbery victim «the principal» value of the stolen item, but did not give him the additional one-fifth payment required of a robber, he is not required to pursue the robbery victim in order to return the additional one-fifth payment. The Gemara comments: «Apparently,» the additional «one-fifth» payment «is» considered «monetary restitution» rather than a fine. «And» accordingly, «if» the robber «died,» the «heirs» of the robber must «pay it» to the robbery victim.
